episodes.title: Out of a Clear Blue Sky
episodes.summary: Bobby is torn between money and friendship upon his return while Mel is forced to abandon the plane.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.summary: Bobby gambles Mel's plane in a poker game; a DC-3 runs out of fuel at 5000 feet.

episodes.title: Hijacked
episodes.summary: An Arctic Air flight is hijacked while flying rig workers to Yellowknife.

episodes.title: All the Vital Things
episodes.summary: Bobby (Adam Beach) lies to gain the trust of an elder.

episodes.title: Northern Lights
episodes.summary: Arctic Air may be involved in a drug overdose in a remote community.

episodes.title: C-TVAK
episodes.summary: Bobby puts Cece's life at risk to find out how his father died.

episodes.title: Vancouver is Such a Screwed-Up City
episodes.summary: Bobby travels south with Mel and Krista to buy a new plane and his old life in Vancouver comes back to haunt him.

episodes.title: The Professional
episodes.summary: Bobby and Mel fight to protect Nelson from a hitman.

episodes.title: New North
episodes.summary: Bobby convinces a high-rolling college roommate to invest in Arctic Air.

episodes.title: Drop in for Lunch
episodes.summary: A routine flight from Watson Lake to Yellowknife turns deadly.

episodes.title: Wildfire
episodes.summary: Bobby and Krista attempt to rescue a group of stranded tourists from a raging forest fire, but they need help from the rest of the Arctic Air crew if they're going to make it out alive.

episodes.title: Bombs Away
episodes.summary: Bobby's sister Deanna is arrested for eco-terrorist bombings, but as Bobby works to clear her name, he learns that there's one more bomb and it's been planted on an Arctic Air plane -- with Krista aboard.

episodes.title: Open Season
episodes.summary: Bobby and Caitlin fly into northern hunting grounds to see Nelson, but a long-awaited brother-sister reunion turns to horror when they learn that Nelson was shot by the very hunters he was hired to guide.

episodes.title: Stormy Weather
episodes.summary: Bobby, Krista and Blake are trapped in an abandoned Dew Line station - only to find out they're not alone.

episodes.title: Old Wounds
episodes.summary: Bobby backs Jim McAllister in a tough-guy boxing tournament as part of a last-ditch bid to save his diamond claim; and Arctic Air falls into crisis when Blake's friend joins the crew.

episodes.title: Dangerous Cargo
episodes.summary: A desperate biologist holds Krista and Bobby at gunpoint in the Arctic Air offices, along with a polar bear.

episodes.title: There's Gold in Them Thar Hills
episodes.summary: A dying trapper gives Dev and Cece the location of a valuable gold claim, setting off a mini gold rush that pits Arctic Air against Bruce Ward and the Comstock Brothers.

episodes.title: Secrets & Lies
episodes.summary: Petra thinks her ex husband has abducted Connor and enlists Bobby's help to get him back, leaving Krista on the hook to plan a 35th anniversary party for Arctic Air.

episodes.title: Hell Hath No Fury
episodes.summary: Troubled rock star, Delilah Fury, embarks on the northern leg of her comeback tour, and Bobby must keep her - and the tour - from falling apart.

episodes.title: Skeletons in the Closet
episodes.summary: Bobby and Mel are stranded in an isolated community after their DC-3 is shot up on the airstrip; and Krista helps Loreen arrange a traditional burial for the bones of her great-great-grandfather.

episodes.title: Blood is Thicker Than Water
episodes.summary: Krista's mother pays a visit to Yellowknife and throws Krista's life into turmoil and Bobby gets his first real chance to play "family" with Connor and Petra.

episodes.title: Fool Me Once
episodes.summary: While a winter storm hammers Yellowknife, a couples' weekend in Calgary goes sideways after the arrival of Blake's sister and Krista's discovery of Bobby and Petra's kiss.

episodes.title: Ts'inada
episodes.summary: Caitlin is taken, but her kidnappers don't want money - they want Nelson.

episodes.title: The River
episodes.summary: Krista's homecoming is cut short when Arctic Air launches a daring search and rescue operation to save Dev and Astrid.

episodes.title: High Water
episodes.summary: Bobby fights against time and politics to evacuate a community before an upstream dam bursts.

episodes.title: The Fling
episodes.summary: Krista and Tag's relationship is tested when an emergency landing leaves them stranded.

episodes.title: The Finish Line
episodes.summary: A high-stakes plane race raises ghosts from Mel's past, forcing Krista and Tag to confront a crisis in their relationship.

episodes.title: The Devils You Know
episodes.summary: Bobby fights to save Petra's life savings when Bruce Ward's involvement in a business deal causes violence and destruction.

episodes.title: On the Edge
episodes.summary: Krista faces a grisly choice when her team attempts a life and death rescue.

episodes.title: Flying Solo
episodes.summary: Bobby and Loreen race to save Caitlin when her first solo flight goes dangerously wrong.

episodes.title: The Fugitive
episodes.summary: A prisoner transport becomes a life and death struggle for Blake and Lindsay, as Krista and Tag reach an impasse in their relationship.

episodes.title: Rites of Passage
episodes.summary: Bobby and Connor's weekend on the land becomes a fight for survival, while a high altitude flight puts Mel and Krista in peril.

episodes.title: Last Drop
episodes.summary: Bobby blames Bruce Ward for his foster sister's death in a dry community, as Blake and Lindsay pursue a murder suspect.

episodes.title: The Fall - Part 1
episodes.summary: Krista's SAR crew is pushed to the limit during a high-altitude rescue, while Bobby is the target of an attack in YK.

episodes.title: The Fall - Part 2
episodes.summary: When disaster strikes, Krista's SAR team is trapped, and Tag clings to life on the mountain; Bobby and Mel race to save them.
